response.sql: WITH race_level AS (SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) as avg_wins_per_race FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId JOIN driverStandings ds ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId), country_level AS (SELECT country, AVG(avg_wins_per_race) as country_avg_wins FROM race_level GROUP BY country), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(country_avg_wins) as overall_avg FROM country_level), above_overall_countries AS (SELECT cl.country, cl.country_avg_wins FROM country_level cl WHERE cl.country_avg_wins > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_average)), above_overall_group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(country_avg_wins) as group_avg FROM above_overall_countries), final_selection AS (SELECT aoc.country, aoc.country_avg_wins, (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_average) as overall_avg, (SELECT group_avg FROM above_overall_group_avg) as group_avg FROM above_overall_countries aoc WHERE aoc.country_avg_wins > (SELECT group_avg FROM above_overall_group_avg)) SELECT country, country_avg_wins, country_avg_wins - overall_avg as above_overall, country_avg_wins - group_avg as above_group FROM final_selection ORDER BY country_avg_wins DESC
